purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association) standard receipt (medical billing) software system. It handles hospital admission (nyuuin) act input processing — specifically the entry and management of inpatient medical procedures and billing data. It interacts with SPA (screen parameter area) files and parameter files stored in /var/tmp/.
purpose.domain: healthcare/medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims processing)

notable_features: Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (latin-1 decoded, hence garbled display)
Large SPA (Screen Parameter Area) file I/O pattern typical of ORCA subsystems
LINE SEQUENTIAL file organization for both parameter and SPA data files
Very large record sizes (PIC X(60000), PIC X(30000)) for inter-program data passing
Extensive COPY statements for shared data structures
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — file-based IPC instead
129 CALL statements indicating heavy subprogram delegation
653 PERFORM statements and 173 GOTO statements — complex procedural logic
Files stored under /var/tmp/ with terminal-ID suffixes (multi-user support)
Revision history spanning 2002–2004 with named developer (NACL)
verdict.notes: The file is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese) but was decoded as latin-1, causing the Japanese comments to appear as garbled latin-1 sequences. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical billing system for Japan. The large file size (553 KB, 13007 lines) and extensive flag/index/working-storage areas confirm a mature, production-grade application. The COPY statements reference copybooks that are not included in this file.
